text: I can't promise how every case is handled, so please check Albert's Terms of Service or contact the team in the app for the definitive answer. Instant Advances aren't traditional loans: there's no interest or late fees, and Albert doesn't run a credit check to approve them. If a repayment doesn't go through, you can generally expect Albert to retry the debit from your linked account and to restrict your access to future advances until the balance is settled. If you're worried about repaying, reach out in the app before your due date, because Albert may be able to help you adjust the timing.
